$comment: Pinned zowex SDK build used by regular CI (push/PR) and by `node scripts/sdk-switch.js pin`.
The tarball itself is NOT committed - it is staged into resources/ on demand and gitignored.
This file is the reproducibility record: url + sha256 identify the exact bytes, and upstream
records which zowe/zo commit and Release run produced them.
To move the pin forward: `node scripts/sdk-switch.js nightly --write-pin`, then commit the
resulting changes to this file, packages/zowe-mcp-server/package.json and package-lock.json.
Nightly snapshots are pruned upstream after roughly six weeks; refresh the pin before then or
CI will start failing to fetch it.
